instruction: Go to https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons, review the button design guidelines, and copy the main content from the 'Buttons' section into a document called 'button_guidelines.docx' on the desktop, omitting resources and related links.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG buttons page and saving primary content to docx excluding resources/links sections. Evaluator checks for: (1) basic keywords (button, interface, design, user, action), (2) button-specific terminology (toggle button, system button, button states, etc.) to verify content authenticity, (3) Apple HIG-specific terms (SF Symbols, iOS, macOS, etc.) to verify source, (4) exclusion patterns (related links, resources, see also, etc.) to ensure excluded sections were not included, (5) minimum word count of 150 and at least 5 paragraphs for primary content. Custom getter extracts document content and structure, custom metric validates keyword presence, source authenticity, exclusion compliance, and document completeness.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 15% exclusion compliance (no resources/links sections), 15% word count (>=150 words), 10% paragraph count (>=5 paragraphs), 20% basic keywords (5 key terms), 25% button-specific keywords (at least 3 of 10 terms), 15% Apple HIG keywords (at least 2 of 8 terms)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator successfully addresses exclusion requirement by checking for exclusion patterns ('related links', 'resources', 'see also', 'download', etc.) and deducting 15% of score if any are found in the document.

Content authenticity is verified through button-specific keywords (10 terms including 'toggle button', 'system button', 'button states', 'button anatomy', etc.) requiring at least 3 matches for 25% of total score.

Source verification is implemented via Apple HIG-specific keywords (8 terms including 'SF Symbols', 'Human Interface Guidelines', 'iOS', 'macOS', 'Apple') requiring at least 2 matches for 15% of total score.
Primary content verification is reasonable with min word count of 150 (15% score) and min paragraph count of 5 (10% score), ensuring substantial content was captured.
Postconfig correctly activates the document window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring getter can access the saved file.
Data flow is correct: getter extracts document content from specified path, metric receives content and checks all requirements against expected rules.
Partial credit scoring is well-designed with breakdown across multiple verification dimensions (exclusion compliance, word/paragraph counts, keyword categories).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making button-specific keyword threshold stricter (e.g., require 4-5 out of 10 instead of 3) to further strengthen content authenticity verification.
The exclusion pattern check is binary (15% or 0%). Consider partial credit if only minor exclusion violations are found (e.g., a single occurrence vs. entire sections).
Word count threshold of 150 may be slightly low for comprehensive button guidelines. Consider increasing to 200-250 words to better ensure primary content completeness.
